These synthetic fixtures reproduce the September 25 mixed-PDF review finding.
They contain no operational shipment data and must not be counted as unseen pilot cases.

- bl-mixed.pdf: all seven fields in page 1 text, gross weight 42,000 KG;
  page 2 is an image-only amendment explicitly superseding it with 43,000 KG.
- bl-text-amendment.pdf: the same amendment represented as text (control).
- bl-scan-only.pdf: the image-only amendment, with no text layer (control).

The original amendment rendering was visually inspected before these fixtures
were retained. Regression tests exercise the actual parser and comparison pipeline.
